Definition: the chase; also game (thus taken); (generally) lunch (especially for a journey)
BiblicalUsage: tsayid names the hunt; game; provisions. It appears 16 times in Scripture, including Genesis 25:28 and Genesis 27:5.
TheologicalSignificance: My position: tsayid carries the precision of a God who says what He means.
